note: Hand-written, unlike the datamined sets beside it: no parser generates this file, and re-running the datamine leaves it alone. Each entry is a dated, player-facing summary of what changed on the site, newest first. Facts only: no commit hashes, build numbers or tips. Items take **bold** for tab names.

items: **Weapons** and **Stats**: shotguns show their close-range bonus. Every enemy takes extra damage from a shotgun hit: ×10 within 5 m, falling to the listed damage at 28 m. The Surplus Shotgun's 270 is 2,700 up close. The Stats tab used to say shotgun damage drops below the listed number with distance; it doesn't.

**Weapons**: the CLAW, XM25, Painless, Surplus Rifle and Surplus Shotgun now have pages. The list was built from attachment pages, so weapons with no attachments listed were left out. The CLAW, XM25 and both surplus guns also appear on **Ammo** under the rounds they fire.
Game data updated to the current game version (0.9.5.3).

**Ammo** and **Weapons**: headshots are now explained the way the game scores them. A head hit removes a share of the target's health bar (damage × caliber ÷ 450), and each round and weapon shows that share.

**Detection**: every range is now the one an enemy uses against players (several see rival factions from much farther away), and hearing adds the range at which an enemy hears a player who has been shooting. Noise radii updated: walking is now heard at 6 m, sprinting at 15 m.
**Enemies**: each card's senses and health are read from that enemy's own game data. This corrected several: the mechs and Opal no longer list ESP, and turrets now list hearing.
**Enemies**: the Blind Mother's card shows her short-range vision and how she is killed. Orgamech and MeatMan dash ranges corrected to start at 4 m, not 0.4 m.

**Enemies**: mounted weapons' rates of fire corrected. The cards showed the game's time between shots as shots per second, so the Chopper's minigun read 0.1 a second instead of 10, and the Stilt Walker's shoulder missiles 7 a second instead of one every 7 seconds. Weapon damage is rounded to two decimal places.
**Enemies**: with the Unkillables toggle on, the tab says the mod doesn't work on the current game version yet, and links both the fix and the original mod.
**Economy**: the Tunnels/Regions tags are gone; they came from item tags the game doesn't use. Each item has a **drops** link to every crate, corpse and wreck that drops it.
**Drops**: World Rare-Loot lists what the game actually scatters into containers on every map, and Map Rare-Loot adds each map's own quest items.
Strategy tips removed across the site: pages state the mechanics and the numbers.
New **Changelog** tab. On mid-size screens the tab bar now scrolls on its own instead of making the whole page scroll sideways.
